Root Node.description: A living arena root that protects and regenerates linked enemies.

Rootbound Vanguard.description: An ironbark defender that intercepts attacks aimed at the root network.

stats.skill_act_desc: A heavy guarding strike that raises threat and protects linked roots.

Canopy Witch.description: A rootbound caster that restores damaged nodes and exposes heroes.

stats.skill_act_desc: Heals an ally and leaves the target vulnerable to the grove.

Sap Colossling.description: A slow bruiser that grows stronger while the root network restores it.

Thorn Choir.description: A singing mass of thorns that punishes repeated attack patterns.

stats.skill_act_desc: A sweeping ranged volley followed by a thorny counter stance.

Burrowing Heartworm.description: A mobile disruptor that weakens the strongest attacker.

stats.skill_act_desc: Burrows into the formation and reduces a hero's attack.

Orrun, the Walking Grove.description: An ancient grove that chose to become a colossal walking guardian.

stats.skill_act_desc: A colossal raid-wide shockwave whose force is shared by the front line.

Drowned Oarsman.description: A drowned bruiser that attacks faster as pressure rises.

Pressure Wisp.description: A fragile bubble spirit whose defeat releases trapped air.

stats.skill_act_desc: A sharp magical burst fueled by the Pressure Gauge.

Abyssal Lamplighter.description: A channeler that forces the drowned avenue toward crushing pressure.

stats.skill_act_desc: Channels a pressure wave that silences and weakens healing.

Reefplate Sentinel.description: A reef-armored defender with immense physical resistance.

Tide-Sworn Cantor.description: A drowned singer that turns afflictions into healing and pressure.

stats.skill_act_desc: Restores allies and leaves the opposing formation vulnerable.

Nhalassa, Bell Beneath the Tide.description: The will inside a drowned bell, given shape by impossible pressure.

stats.skill_act_desc: An unavoidable raid-wide toll whose damage rises with pressure.

Starhide Prowler.description: An evasive celestial hunter pursuing the weakest defense.

Cometwing Hunter.description: A ranged predator that accelerates beneath the Ranged sign.

stats.skill_act_desc: A luminous ranged barrage with increased critical force.

Orbit Devourer.description: A dense orbiting beast vulnerable to physical pressure and decay.

Voidglass Seer.description: A seer that changes the resistance pattern of its allies.

stats.skill_act_desc: A voidglass ray that exposes one defense while strengthening another.

Menagerie Stitcher.description: A celestial surgeon that copies temporary advantages.

stats.skill_act_desc: Restores allies and copies an offensive blessing.

Veyra, the Star-Eating Chimera.description: A three-headed celestial predator attempting to consume the company's constellation.

stats.skill_act_desc: Cycles through lion, roc, and serpent power before a raid-ending celestial strike.

Dawnless Knight.description: A final-road defender whose armor changes with the Eclipse Clock.

Root-Crowned Herald.description: A Worldroot priest sustaining the enemies of the Last Road.

stats.skill_act_desc: Powerful regeneration that can be answered by decay and focus fire.

Lastlight Seraph.description: A radiant attacker that steals stored Lastlight.

stats.skill_act_desc: A raid-wide flare that strengthens the eclipse.

Hollow Roadwarden.description: A countering bruiser that guards the route beyond the ending.

Eclipse Engine.description: An arena construct that accelerates the Eclipse Clock.

stats.skill_act_desc: A temporal shockwave that weakens healing during Total Eclipse.

Aster Null, Eclipse Incarnate.description: The final road's living eclipse, divided between first dawn and absolute night.

stats.skill_act_desc: Alternating physical and magical devastation culminating in a lethal eclipse.
